description: Make the sound for a video from its picture: music to what happens on screen, sound effects for what is seen, or both, as long as the video is. Returns its id at once: call get_song with it until it's done. Then it gives the audio as MP3 and WAV, and the video with that audio on it as an MP4; no stems. Counts as one song for each kind of sound made (two for both), and reading the video uses credits too, after an account's first video. With a seed, the same video, sound, words and seed give back the version already made, without counting again.

prompt.description: What the person said about how it should sound, in their words. Left out, it's made from the picture alone.

seed.description: Gives back the same version for the same video, sound and words (a retry that doesn't count again); left out, a new one each time.

sound.description: "music" for music to what happens on screen, "sound_effects" for the sounds of what is seen, "both" (the default) for the two together.

video.description: A video the person attached, instead of video_url.

download_url.description: Where to fetch the video (https, MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 1 minute and 200 MB).

video_url.description: An https link to the video (MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 1 minute and 200 MB).

name: score_video
title: Score a video
